description: This file defines the TitlesFragment class for an Android application, extending ListFragment and implementing ActionBar.TabListener. It manages a list of titles, handles tab selection, enables drag-and-drop for list items, and communicates user selections to an activity via a callback interface.

classes.name: TitlesFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of titles, manages tab interactions, drag-and-drop gestures, and communicates selection events to its host activity.

classes.name: TitlesFragment.OnItemSelectedListener
classes.description: Callback interface that must be implemented by the activity hosting TitlesFragment to respond to list item selections.

classes.name: TitlesFragment.MyDragShadowBuilder
classes.description: A custom View.DragShadowBuilder that defines the appearance of list items during a drag operation.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Ensures that the hosting activity implements the OnItemSelectedListener interface and assigns it to mListener.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Performs fragment setup after the activity and view hierarchy are created, including initializing tabs, populating the list, and configuring drag behavior.

methods.name: populateTitles
methods.description: Loads entries for a given category into the list adapter.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on list items, notifying the host activity of the selection.

methods.name: selectPosition
methods.description: Highlights a specified list item and notifies the host of the selection.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current list position and category for state restoration.

methods.name: MyDragShadowBuilder
methods.description: Creates a visual shadow during drag operations, using a custom drawable background.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Responds to tab selection events by repopulating titles and resetting selection.
